set.body:
Extend the admitted viewer without importing inference or estimator logic into rendering. Reuse VolToSurfMorphism, surface sampling, image spaces, and spatial operator plans to materialize CPU-reference vertex fields from volumes. Add typed vertex, ribbon, sampling, reducer, fill-value, and quality policies; GPU acceleration is a backend capability, not a distinct public model. Add connectivity display plans over typed surface nodes/vertices with explicit weight threshold, top-N, sign/color, line/tube, and region-filter semantics sourced from connectivity results.

Acceptance: CPU projection is the oracle on JVM and Scala.js; surface/world/voxel transforms have asymmetric differential fixtures; JavaFX can consume materialized fields even when GPU projection is unavailable; browser GPU projection matches the CPU oracle within declared numeric tolerance; connectivity filters preserve node identity and negative-weight semantics; performance and memory receipts cover volume upload/materialization and large edge sets.
set.title: Surface projection and networks: volume overlays, ribbon sampling, and connectivity layers
